description:
Are you passionate about software quality and test automation? Do you enjoy finding bugs before users do and continuously improving the way teams deliver software? Are you looking to work in a collaborative Agile environment with international exposure? Then, this job might be for you!

Job description and responsibilities:

Within a cross-functional development team, as a QA Engineer, you will ensure that features delivered by your team meet the highest quality standards. You will integrate quality throughout all development stages — writing test cases, running manual and automated tests, identifying defects, and contributing to continuous improvement.

As part of your missions, you will:

- Contribute to the test strategy by providing expertise on coverage needs

- Execute manual and automated tests and validate features before delivery

- Prioritize testing activities based on release risks and team priorities

- Write, maintain, and improve test cases, test scenarios, and test documentation

- Identify and report defects clearly; collaborate with developers to resolve them

- Measure test coverage and report results accurately in shared tools

- Participate in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, bug triage

- Collaborate with developers and Product Owners to clarify acceptance criteria

- Automate repetitive test scenarios to optimize testing time

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing practices and processes

What we are looking for:

- Solid experience in manual and automated software testing

- Familiarity with test automation frameworks (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)

- Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g. Xray, Jira)

- Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies

- Ability to write clear, structured test cases and test reports

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Good verbal and written communication skills in English (French is a plus)

- Great to have:

- Experience with performance, security, or API testing tools

- Experience with CI/CD environments/ Background in software development or technical architecture/ Experience working in distributed or internationa
